item.title: 2-alarm fire tears through apartment building in Lindenwold
item.description: Firefighters battled a 2-alarm fire Tuesday morning that ripped through an apartment complex in Lindenwold. Firefighters responded to an apartment complex on the 800 block of Chews Landing Road around 7:30 a.m. Tuesday. Investigators say the blaze roared to 2-alarms and ripped through a few apartments before firefighters got control around noon.No injuries have been reported at this time. There is no word on what caused the fire.
